purpose: Play a published episode natively on Android and iOS, then check background and lock-screen control, interruption and route change, sleep timer, cold-launch resume, large text and screen readers; a desktop host render only covers layout.
preconditions: A local or QA backend with a published episode and delivered audio the user authorized; never production
A listener test account created through the official flow; no credential in this file
A named Android device or emulator and a named iOS device or simulator; a platform that cannot be exercised is reported blocked, not skipped silently
TalkBack and VoiceOver walkthroughs need the real reader enabled on the named target

steps.action: Open the library, choose the published episode and start playback.
steps.expected: The UI reports the real player state: Loading until audio runs, then Playing; elapsed and total time are text; the title is not clipped.

steps.action: Background the app, lock the device and use the OS media controls to pause, play and seek.
steps.expected: Playback continues; lock-screen and notification controls show title, artwork and position consistent with the active publication; the app state matches on return.

steps.action: Cause an audio interruption (a call or competing audio) and remove headphones if hardware allows.
steps.expected: The player does not claim user playback during the interruption; user intent and position are preserved; playback does not resume unexpectedly after an explicit pause.

steps.action: Set the sleep timer to a short value and let it expire.
steps.expected: Playback stops at expiry and does not resume afterwards; the timer state is understandable from the app and from the OS controls.

steps.action: Terminate the app from the OS and launch it again.
steps.expected: The restored session offers resume with the real position and does not auto-play after a cold launch.

steps.action: Set the largest OS text size and review the library, mini-player and full player.
steps.expected: No clipped diacritics; no hidden actionable label; transport controls and their touch targets remain usable; safe areas are respected.

steps.action: With TalkBack on Android and VoiceOver on iOS, operate play, pause, seek, speed and bookmark.
steps.expected: Controls announce action, item and state; playback is operable without the cover or a waveform; time and position are readable.

steps.action: Open a downloaded episode with the network off, and review an interrupted or corrupt download if the environment can produce one.
steps.expected: A completed download plays offline; an interrupted, corrupt or insufficient-storage download is visible and recoverable; an incomplete file is never shown as ready.

device_only_checks: sleep timer expiry in the background
offline playback of a completed download
forbidden_actions: Starting any production, regeneration or publication action
Changing account, subscription or permission settings
Deleting downloads, bookmarks or progress the run did not create
Installing system certificates or changing device security settings
cleanup: Remove only the downloads, bookmarks and progress this run created; retain the account and the build for the recheck.

What is the offline validity and revalidation policy for downloads? Steps that depend on it are inconclusive until it is chosen.
